items.text: REFERRED TO COMMERCE, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND SMALL BUSINESS
COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5639

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the economic development law, in relation to creating
the micro business outreach center assistance program


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :

This hill will create a means of supporting existing business outreach
centers and creating additional centers that are serving micro
enterprises as well as providing them with the opportunity to
facilitate individuals of communities that are geographically and
socially isolated from the mainstream economy with access to economic
development counseling services and funds.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :

This legislation amends the economic development law by adding a new
Article 9-B to define and create the micro business outreach centers
program. The measure also sets forth reporting requirements.

 JUSTIFICATION :

During these difficult economic times, now more than ever, creating
economic development assistance and support opportunities for small
and micro business enterprises is crucial to the economic vitality of
communities throughout New York State. This legislation supports that
goal by ensuring that business outreach centers serving micro
enterprises will he able to leverage federal and state, and other
funding.  The creation of this program will encourage and support
micro-business growth and as a result, create much needed jobs for
hardworking New Yorkers.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New Bill - 2009

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect on the one hundred eightieth day after it
becomes law.

items.name: Commerce, Economic Development And Small Business

summary: Creates the micro business outreach center assistance program within the department of economic development, and provides for its functions, powers and duties; further creates the micro business outreach center network; establishes a reporting requirement by the commissioner of economic development.
title: Creates the micro business outreach center assistance program and micro business outreach center
